tools.name: prepare_fax
tools.description: Prepare one PDF fax and return its price and Stripe checkout link. This stores the document but does not send or charge. Completing checkout authorizes sending to the displayed recipient. fax_number must be a US fax number: 10 digits (5155551234), optionally prefixed with 1 or +1 (E.164 such as +151

tools.name: get_fax_status
tools.description: Check your prepared fax using its secret draft_token. Returns payment and delivery status. A processing fax has not yet been delivered. Poll no more than once every 15 seconds.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_fax_status" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
